'''Dimintheis Fitzharmon''' is a noble of [[Varrock]]. He is featured heavily in the quest [[Family Crest]], and plays a crucial role in the quest [[Defender of Varrock]]. He is a descendant of an important Elder of [[Avarrocka]], and is the father of [[Avan]], [[Caleb]], and [[Johnathon]] Fitzharmon. His house is located south of Varrock's east gate, north of the Fancy dress shop in the fenced off area.
